cmake_minimum_required( VERSION 3.10 FATAL_ERROR )

project( "Tracy-main" LANGUAGES CXX )

set( AE_EXTERNAL_PATH "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." )
include( "${AE_EXTERNAL_PATH}/config.cmake" )

set( TRACY_STATIC 			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( TRACY_ENABLE 			ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( TRACY_Fortran			OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( TRACY_ON_DEMAND 		ON  CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )	# avoid buffering until a client connects
set( TRACY_ONLY_LOCALHOST 	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )
set( TRACY_NO_BROADCAST 	OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE )

include( "origin_CMakeLists.txt" )

install( FILES "LICENSE" DESTINATION "." )
install( TARGETS "TracyClient" LIBRARY DESTINATION "lib" ARCHIVE DESTINATION "lib" )
